entities.name: Víctor Luengo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor José Luengo Ciscar is a former Spanish professional basketball player. Luengo played the majority of his career with Valencia Basket, as he spent 14 seasons with the club. He finished his career with two seasons for Gandía BA in the second division LEB Oro. His jersey number 15 was retired by Valencia.
